principle: Human behavior is learned only when FACT output can be traced back to corresponding order source and the transformation is reproducible.

learned: multiple MAIN/package components stay together in one configuration
net accessories can be separate upsells only in verified net context
flavor/color/size may be ignored only where history proves they are non-accounting variants

datasets.scope: main quantity tiers + separate refill upsell + historical pricing
learned: refill/mines can be separately counted upsells
pricing learns from stable historical normal FACT values
ambiguous fulfillment promotions require evidence/human confirmation
fulfillment origin CN/FR precedes destination-country grouping
same order id must not be blindly deduplicated
fact-only manual lines do not train
unexplained quantity/configuration mismatch does not partially train
